m: अभि-√ 1. दा -ददाति, to give, bestow (for a purpose), MBh. iii, 13309.
अभि-दापन n. the being trampled on by elephants as a punishment (?).
a: अभिदापनं — The being trodden under the foot by elephants (?).

m: अभि-√ दास् Ved. -दासति (Subj. 3. sg. -दासत् [RV. vi, 5, 4] or -दासात्, AV. v, 6, 10) to consider and treat as an enemy.
अभि-√ 2. दी (Imper. 2. sg. -दिदीहि) to radiate, beam forth or towards, RV. ix, 108, 9.
अभि-√ दीक्ष् to consecrate one's self (for a purpose, acc.), PBr.
अभि-√ दीप् to blaze towards, Hariv. : Caus. दीपयति, to cause to shine, make brilliant, Car.; to blaze or shine all round, AV. iv, 19, 3.
अभि-दूतम् ind. towards the messenger, Śiś.
अभि-दूति ind. to or towards a female messenger, Śiś. ix, 56 (quoted in Sāh.)
अभि-दूषित mfn. wounded, injured, Suśr.
अभि-दधत् mfn. pr. p. of 1. अभि-√ धा, q.v.
अभि-ददि See अभि- √ 1. दा.
अभि-ददि m. an oblation of boiled rice (चरु) upon which ghee has been sprinkled, TS.
अभि-√ दह् to singe, burn, RV. ii, 4, 7 (aor. p. अभि-दक्षत् [Padap. -दक्षत्]), ŚBr. &c.

a: अभिदक्षिणं — ind. To or towards the right (= प्रदक्षिणं q. v.)

m: अभि-दक्षिणम् ind. to or towards the right, Kauś.; KātyŚr.; Lāṭy.

m: अभि-दर्शन See अभि-√ दृश्.
अभि-दर्शन n. becoming visible, appearance, Mn. ix, 274.
अभि-दष्ट mfn. (√ दंश्), bitten.
अभि-देवन n. a board for playing at dice, MBh. ix, 760.
अभि-√ दृश् (Inf. -द्रष्टुम्) to look at: Caus. -दर्शयति, to show; to point out, denounce any one (acc.), MBh. i, 7740 : Pass. -दृश्-यते, to be visible, be in view, appear, Mn. ix, 308, &c.
a: अभिदृश् — {c1c} P. To look at, behold. --Caus. 1 To show, point out. --2 To show oneself to, appear before. --pass. 1 To be seen, be visible, appear. --2 To be considered or thought.

m: अभि-√ दिश् to point out, PBr.
अभि-दिग्ध mfn. polished, glazed (in the fire, तपसा) i.e. sharp, AV. v, 18, 8.
अभि-√ दिह् to wrap up, envelop in ĀpŚr.

m: अभि-दिप्सु mfn. (दिप्स् Desid. of √ दम्भ्), ‘wishing to deceive’, inimical, cunning, RV. ii, 23, 10 and 13.
अभि-दोहन n. milking upon, ĀpŚr.
अभि-दोह्य n. (impers.) to be milked upon, ĀpŚr.
अभि-दोषम् ind. about dusk, ĀpŚr.

m: अभि-√ 2. द्रा (aor. Subj. -द्रासत्) to overtake, RV. viii, 47, 7.

pu॰ aBi + druha--GaY । 1 AkroSe 2 anizwacintane, 3 apakAre ca । “nAmajAtigrahaM tezAnaBidrIheRa kurvataH” । manuH “BUtendriyAnaBidroho Darmohi paramomataH” kA॰ Ka॰
m: अभि-द्रोह m. injuring, RV.; Mn. &c.
a: अभिद्रोहः — 1 Injuring, plotting against, harm, cruelty, oppression; Ms. 8. 271; Ki. 11. 21. --2 Abuse; censure.

m: अभि-√ 2. द्रु to run up to or near, RV. x, 75, 2, &c.; to attack, overrun, infest.
a: अभिद्रु — {c1c} P. 1 (a) To run up to, run near; पयस्यभिद्रवति भुवं युगावधौ Śi. 17. 40. (b) To invade, march against, fall upon, attack, assail; मकरंदेन प्रतिहतो जामाता बलात्कारेण अभिद्रवन् Māl. 7 laying violent hands on; गजा इवान्योन्यमभिद्रवंतः (वारिधराः) Mk. 5. 21; Ve. 3. --2 To overrun,; infest, harass, afflict; जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिवेदनाभिरमिद्रुतं (देहं) Mb. --3 To come over, pass or run over. --4 To befall. --Caus. To rout, put to flight; पुररक्षानभिद्राव्य Dk. 14.

m: अभि-द्रुग्ध mfn. injured, oppressed, BhP.
injuring, oppressing, MBh. v, 2160; PārGṛ.

m: 1. अभि-√ द्रुह् -द्रुह्यति (aor. Subj. 3. pl. -द्रुहन्; perf. 1. p. -दुद्रोह) to hate, seek to injure or maliciously assail, RV. &c.: Desid. (p. -दुद्रुक्षत्) id., Kāṭh.
2. अभि-द्रुह् mfn. seeking to injure, inimical, RV. i, 122, 9 (nom. -ध्रुक्) and ii, 27, 16 (cf. अन्-अभिद्रुह्.)
a: अभिद्रुह् — {c4c} P. (A. in epic poetry) To hate, seek to injure or maliciously assail, plot against (with acc.); नित्यमस्मच्छरीरमभिद्रोग्धुं यतते Mu. 1, 2; क्रूरमभिद्रुह्यति Sk. (sometimes with dat. also); मया पुनरेभ्य एवाभिद्रुग्धमज्ञेन U. 6; नभिद्रुह्यति भूतेभ्यः Bhāg., Mu. 5.
अभिद्रुह् — a. Ved. Seeking to injure, inimical.

m: अभि-द्रुह्यमाण mfn. being injured.
अभि-द्रुत mfn. run towards, attacked.
अभि-द्रुत्य ind.p. having attacked.
अभि-√ 2. दु (pr. p. m. nom. दुन्वन्) to burn or pain by burning, AV. v, 22, 2.
अभि-√ दुह् to milk in addition to, TBr.; Caus. P. to cause to milk in addition to, ĀpŚr.
अभि-√ दुष् -दूषयति, to contaminate; to wound.
अभि-दुष्ट mfn. contaminated, MBh.
अभि-द्यु mfn. directed to heaven, tending or going to heaven, RV.
heavenly, bright, RV.; ŚBr.
a: अभिद्यु — a. 1 Directed to heaven, tending or going to heaven, heavenward. --2 Heavenly. --3 Bright, brilliant. --द्युः A half month.
